responsibility: Declares helpers that convert front-end symbols into fully qualified assembler-visible names. Its API distinguishes between a symbol’s full logical name and a fully scoped assembly name, encapsulating gm2’s naming convention for modules, inner modules, procedures, exported symbols, and target underscore prefixes so other code-generation modules can request stable backend symbol names without duplicating scope logic.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the public naming interface for M2AsmUtil: it declares the two exported queries that return fully qualified logical and assembler-visible symbol names. Unlike M2AsmUtil.mod, it does not implement scope walking, export qualification rules, library-name prefixing, or optional leading-underscore handling.
